parts.when: [Opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) or [either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after one of your **WAR DOG** units that has not yet been **selected to attack** in the phase is **destroyed**.
parts.target: That **WAR DOG** unit, despite its destruction.
parts.effect: Before its **[Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise)** is resolved, the unit can shoot or fight, but its attacks can target nothing except the enemy unit that destroyed it, and only while that unit can be targeted. Then, once any [Consolidation moves](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move) are made, resolve its Deadly Demise as normal.

data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) or [either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after one of your **WAR DOG** units that has not yet been **selected to attack** in the phase is **destroyed**.

**Target:** That **WAR DOG** unit, despite its destruction.

**Effect:** Before its **[Deadly Demise](vsdata:core-ability/deadly-demise)** is resolved, the unit can shoot or fight, but its attacks can target nothing except the enemy unit that destroyed it, and only while that unit can be targeted. Then, once any [Consolidation moves](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move) are made, resolve its Deadly Demise as normal.
